decisions.reason: Correctly grounds attempt 1 in ls-remote-tags.txt (v0.9.5 and v0.9.2-v0.9.6 absent, list jumps v0.9.1 to v0.9.7) and sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main with no tag refspecs; explicitly rejects network/typo explanations and calls it a tag-distribution defect.

Uses dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) and compat-table.md to state v0.9.7 targets the 0.1.2-alpha.1 client API whose useConversation seat is missing on the consumer's older rc.2 runtime; explains that install success and restart do not fix static bundle-vs-host incompatibility.

Correctly selects v0.9.3 grounded in the rc.1 verification plus the additive rc.2 note and honors the freeze with no upgrade, but wrongly asserts v0.9.3 'exists on the mirror' when ls-remote-tags.txt omits it, presents the command as immediately installable, and gives no conditional verified-commit/tag-publication alternative.

Proposes an explicit non-forced 'git push "$remote" --tags' per mirror added to the branch-only sync script, plus a post-sync ls-remote tag-comparison verification gate per mirror; branch sync alone is not relied on.

Proposes per-DSH-version install pins (v0.9.3 command for 0.1.1-rc.x users, v0.9.7 for 0.1.2-alpha.x) with an explicit compatibility matrix and manifest-encoded compatibility ranges, rejecting newest-tag defaults; only the two evidenced DSH lines are supported, no untested alphas generalized.
